label: Source of {{name}}
load.failed.title: Couldn't read {{name}}
load.failed.body: The agent on this computer didn't give its source file ({{code}}). Try again.
load.failed.unreadable: The agent on this computer answered with something that isn't a source file. Try again.
load.gone.title: {{name}} is not here any more
load.gone.body: No agent by this name is left on this computer. Go back to the list of agents.
readonly: {{name}} is built into Hoody. Its definition can't be edited here.
new: This agent has no file of its own yet. Saving creates yours; the built-in one stays as the starting point.
tooBig: This file is over 1 MiB, the most the agent keeps. Shorten it to save.
refused.generic: The agent didn't accept this file, so nothing was written ({{code}}).
refused.bad_request: The agent didn't accept this file, so nothing was written. Check the lines at the top: the name has to be this agent's name, and the model and effort have to be ones it knows.
refused.forbidden: This computer doesn't let you change this agent, so nothing was written.
refused.read_only: This agent is built in and can't be changed, so nothing was written.
refused.unsent: The save wasn't sent, so nothing was written ({{code}}).
unsure: The answer to your save didn't arrive. It may have been saved. We have not sent it again.
unsure.failed: We couldn't read the file to check. Try again.
conflict: This agent's file changed since you opened it, so nothing was saved. Your text is still here.
conflict.keep.hint: Your text replaces the file the next time you press Save.
conflict.theirsFailed: We couldn't read the file to compare ({{code}}). Try again.
conflict.theirsGone: The agent's file is gone now, so there is nothing to compare or save over. Your text is still here: copy it before you leave.
diff.title: Saving yours over their file would change it like this
diff.same: Their file is the same as yours.
reload.title: Drop your changes?
reload.body: Your unsaved text is replaced by the file as it is now. This can't be undone.
leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.body: Your changes to {{name}} are not saved.
leave.body.unsure: A save of {{name}} may or may not have gone through, and we haven't checked.
danger.title: Reset or delete
danger.reset.label: Reset to the shipped version
danger.reset.help: Your copy is replaced by the version that comes with Hoody. Your edits to it are lost.
danger.delete.label: Delete this agent
danger.paused.hint: Agents on {{computer}} are paused, and the agent answers these two only when it runs. Resume agents first.
danger.reset.confirmBody: Your copy of {{name}} is replaced by the version that comes with Hoody. Your edits to it are lost.
danger.delete.confirmBody: The file of {{name}} is deleted. If the agent comes with Hoody, the shipped version is back in its place.
danger.delete.consequence1: The agent's file on this computer is removed.
danger.delete.consequence2: If Hoody ships an agent by this name, the shipped version takes its place; otherwise new chats can't pick it. Chats already using it keep going.
danger.done.reset: Reset. {{name}} is the shipped version again.
danger.done.delete: Deleted. {{name}} is gone from this computer's own agents.
danger.paused: Agents on {{computer}} are paused, so nothing was done. Resume agents, then try again.
danger.refused: The agent didn't do it, and nothing changed ({{code}}).
danger.unsure: We don't know if this went through: the agent's answer didn't say. We have not sent it again.
unsure.same: The file looks the same as before your save. That doesn't show the save didn't happen: it may still land.
unsure.gone: The agent's file is gone, so we can't tell what happened to your save. Your text is still here: copy it before you leave.
stale: The file below may be out of date: it could not be read again after the reset.
forget.title: Stop tracking this?
forget.body: We could not tell whether it went through, and we have not sent it again. If you stop here the screen will not say either way. It may still have happened.
diff.cut: {{n}} more lines are not shown. Load their file to see the whole file.
danger.checkFailed: We couldn't read the file to check. Try again.
danger.seenSame: The file looks the same as before. That doesn't show nothing happened: it may still go through, or the same text was written back.
danger.seenChanged: The file is different now. That doesn't show this was done: someone may have edited it.
danger.seenGone: The agent's file is gone. A reset leaves a file, so this doesn't show the reset ran.
unsure.changed: The file is different now. That doesn't show what happened to your save: it may have landed before another change, or may still land.
abandon.title: Stop tracking this save?
abandon.body: We could not tell whether your save went through, and we have not sent it again. If you stop here it may still land later, even after a reset. Your text stays in the editor, and your next Save is checked against the file as we last saw it.
editor.title: Edit the file
